title: Install a runner
lead: A runner executes builds and checks. Pick where to put it.
name: Runner name
nameHint: Optional. A short suffix is added so you can install several runners.
capabilitiesFailed: Could not find out what can be installed on this machine.
busy: An install of this kind is already running. Wait for it to finish.

docker.title: Docker next to the Studio
docker.lead: The Studio starts a runner container through its docker.sock. The runner survives restarts and connects by itself.

kubernetes.title: Deployment in the cluster
kubernetes.lead: The Studio creates a runner Deployment in its namespace under a separate ServiceAccount allowed to touch build pods only.

docker.no_socket: The Studio cannot see docker.sock. In the default install it has no Docker access on purpose: the socket is root on the host. Use the SSH install or the command next to the token.
docker.docker_unreachable: docker.sock exists, but Docker does not answer or the Studio has no right to the socket.
docker.no_permission: The Studio has no rights to Docker.

kubernetes.disabled: Turned off in the chart (runner.installFromUi.enabled). Shared runners are off on production on purpose, so there is no button by default.
kubernetes.not_in_cluster: The Studio does not run inside a Kubernetes cluster.
kubernetes.no_permission: The Studio ServiceAccount may not create a Deployment, Secret and volume in its namespace.

command.title: On another machine
command.lead: Get a token and a ready docker run command or a service script and run it there.

instances.title: Installs without a runner
instances.lead: These Deployments or containers were installed from the admin area, but their runner is not in the table above: it was revoked, has not connected yet or cannot connect. If the runner was revoked, remove the install and install a new one.

removeBody.kubernetes: The Studio revokes the runner and deletes its Deployment, the Secret with its token and the data volume. As with “Revoke runner”, the jobs it is running are handed to another runner and its token stops working. You do not need to revoke the runner separately, and it cannot be brought back: you will need a new install.
removeBody.docker: The Studio revokes the runner and deletes its container. The data directory on the host stays. As with “Revoke runner”, the jobs it is running are handed to another runner and its token stops working. You do not need to revoke the runner separately, and it cannot be brought back: you will need a new install.
removeBody.kubernetesOrphan: The Studio deletes the Deployment, the Secret with the token and the data volume. There is no runner with this install in the Studio, so there is nothing to revoke; the install registration token is revoked if it is still valid.
removeBody.dockerOrphan: The Studio deletes the container. The data directory on the host stays. There is no runner with this install in the Studio, so there is nothing to revoke; the install registration token is revoked if it is still valid.

instances.removeFailed: The runner is revoked, but the install could not be removed completely. It stays in the Installs without a runner block: remove it again.
instances.removeBusy: This install is being updated right now. Wait for the update to finish and remove it again.

succeeded: The runner is installed and connected to the Studio.

error.unexpected: The install failed for an unexpected reason. See the Studio log for details.
error.image_pull_failed: Could not pull the runner image. Check that Docker can reach the registry.
error.container_start_failed: Docker could not start the container.
error.kube_forbidden: The cluster refused the request. Check the Studio ServiceAccount Role.
error.kube_failed: The cluster returned an error while creating resources.
error.register_timeout: The runner started but did not connect to the Studio within three minutes. Check that it can reach the Studio address and retry.
error.engine_requires_gpu: The machine has no NVIDIA GPU, and this engine needs one.
error.not_ready: The server did not become ready in time.
error.model_server_public_needs_key: Ollama has no API key, so it cannot be exposed.
error.model_server_public_unconfirmed: Confirm that the server will be reachable from the network.
error.not_installed: Install not found: the runner Deployment or container is already gone or was not created from the admin area.
error.rollout_failed: The cluster could not roll out the new pod (ProgressDeadlineExceeded). Check the Deployment and pod events.
error.rollout_timeout: The new runner pod did not become ready within 15 minutes. Check the pod events and the cluster access to the image.
error.reconnect_timeout: The runner restarted but did not come online with the Studio version within three minutes. Check its log; the details show the version it connected with, if it did.
error.runner_revoked: The runner record was revoked during the update.

ssh.rowLead: The Studio logs in over SSH, detects the system and Docker, and installs the runner as a service. You confirm the host key fingerprint yourself.
ssh.title: Install a runner over SSH
ssh.lead: The address and login are used only for the install unless you save them below.
ssh.disabled: SSH install is turned off on this instance (HSE_STUDIO__RUNNER_INSTALL__SSH_ENABLED).
ssh.privateKeyHint: Paste the whole key, for example from the id_ed25519 file. It goes to the Studio server in a single request and is never shown.
ssh.passphraseHint: Optional if the key has no passphrase.
ssh.sudoHint: Needed when the login is not root. With a password the same password is used for sudo; with a key sudo must not ask for one.
ssh.saveOff: By default the password and key live only in the Studio memory during the install and are written nowhere: not to the database, not to the log.
ssh.saveOn: The password or key is stored in the database under the Studio secrets encryption key. You cannot view it, only delete it; it powers one-click update and reinstall.
ssh.saveUnavailable: Saving is turned off on this instance.
ssh.label: Name of the saved access
ssh.fingerprintLead: The Studio received the host key of {{host}}:{{port}}. No credentials have been sent yet.
ssh.fingerprintHint: Compare the fingerprint with what the host itself shows, for example ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub. If it differs, do not continue: the host may be impersonated.
ssh.installDockerHint: The Studio will run the official install script on the host: curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh (through sudo when enabled). Without Docker the runner cannot start.

blockedStep.service: A service cannot be installed on this host: the system is unsupported, or the login is not root and sudo is off.
blockedStep.docker: Install Docker on this system yourself.
blockedStep.default: This step is not possible on this host.

saved.title: Saved accesses
saved.lead: One-click update and reinstall. Passwords and keys are never shown.

error.address_blocked: The address is blocked by the internal-network protection: {{reason}}. Add internal hosts to HSE_STUDIO__RUNNER_INSTALL__SSH_ALLOWLIST; cloud metadata addresses are always blocked.
error.address_unresolved: The host name was not found in DNS.
error.unreachable: The host does not answer on this port.
error.host_key_mismatch: The host key changed after you confirmed it. The install stopped before the password was sent.
error.host_key_changed: The host key differs from the saved one. It may be impersonated; the access was not used.
error.auth_failed: The host did not accept the login, password or key.
error.bad_private_key: The private key could not be read.
error.bad_passphrase: The passphrase does not fit the key.
error.fingerprint_mismatch: The confirmed fingerprint did not match the one shown.
error.not_confirmed: Confirm the host key fingerprint first.
error.plan_blocked: This host cannot be prepared automatically.
error.docker_missing: The host has no Docker. Turn on its installation or install it yourself.
error.service_uninstall_failed: The old service could not be removed.
error.service_not_active: The service started but did not become active.
error.command_timeout: A command on the host did not finish in time.
error.connection_lost: The connection to the host was lost.
error.recon_failed: The host system could not be detected.
error.credentials_expired: The sign-in data expired, start again.
error.install_busy: An install is already running or too many are running.
error.unexpected: The install failed for an unexpected reason. See the Studio log for details.
error.register_timeout: The runner started but did not connect to the Studio within three minutes. Check that the host can reach the Studio address and retry.
error.engine_requires_gpu: The machine has no NVIDIA GPU, and this engine needs one.
error.not_ready: The server did not become ready in time.
error.model_server_public_needs_key: Ollama has no API key, so it cannot be exposed.
error.model_server_public_unconfirmed: Confirm that the server will be reachable from the network.

limits.title: Resource limits (cluster install)
limits.hint: Empty fields keep the Helm defaults. Allowed: runner CPU from 100m, memory from 256Mi; build pods CPU from 500m, memory from 1Gi (TeX needs it); the upper bound is set by the administrator in the chart (runner.installFromUi.maxCpu and maxMemory).
limits.invalid: The limits are not valid or outside the allowed bounds. Check the format (for example 500m, 2, 512Mi, 4Gi) and the bounds in the hint.

upgrade.title: Update runner {{name}}
upgrade.versions: The runner is on v{{from}} now and will be on v{{to}}, the Studio version, after the update.
upgrade.versionsUnknown: After the update the runner will be on v{{to}}, the Studio version.
upgrade.same: The runner is already on v{{to}}, the Studio version. The update applies its settings again by the current rules and restarts it.
upgrade.keeps: Kept: the runner name, its token and record in the Studio, the data volume and the limits it was installed with. No new token is issued, the runner does not need to be revoked or connected again.

how.kubernetes: The Deployment is applied again by the current Studio rules: the image of its version, limits, securityContext, ServiceAccount. The old pod is gone before the new one mounts the data volume.
how.docker: The new image is pulled first, then the container is recreated with the same name, environment and data directory.

upgrade.restart: The runner restarts for a short while. It finishes builds already running for up to 30 seconds; those that do not finish stop with “The runner was stopped during the build” and have to be built again. Queued jobs wait: another online runner picks them up, or this one after the restart.
upgrade.busy: An install or update this way is already running. Wait for it to finish.
upgrade.succeeded: The runner is updated and online again, version v{{version}}.
upgrade.succeededNoRunner: The runner was restarted with the new image. There is no record of it in the Studio, so the connection was not checked.
upgrade.rollback: If the new pod or container does not come up or the runner does not come online with the new version, the Studio brings the previous version back and tells you so.
upgrade.rolledBack: The runner is back on v{{version}}.
upgrade.rolledBackPrevious: The runner is back on the previous version.
upgrade.rollbackFailed: The rollback to the previous version failed too: {{reason}} Check the runner Deployment or container and its log.

rollbackError.rollout_failed: the cluster could not roll out the previous pod (ProgressDeadlineExceeded).
rollbackError.rollout_timeout: the previous pod did not become ready within 15 minutes.
rollbackError.kube_forbidden: the cluster refused the Deployment request.
rollbackError.container_start_failed: Docker could not start the container with the previous image.
rollbackError.unexpected: an unexpected error, see the Studio log for details.
